title: Cross-room carry Stage B-fix: held-box mask on/off counterfactual (2 arms, loaded, single red box)
background: Stage B baseline (freeze 868236f55) had GT door crossing 0/16, box retained 16/16, and it was measured that the held red box appears as a full-width near-field band at the bottom of own RGB (obstacle_avoid 0 vs 4,736 in Stage A). That causal statement was correlation/frame/code-condition only, with no counterfactual run. This experiment runs the counterfactual: identical loaded condition, one arm without any held-object masking (M0) and one arm with the native held-object mask (M1).

M0_mask_off.description: loaded single red box, no held-object mask: obstacle_detections(bgr, servo) exactly as the Stage B baseline

M1_mask_on.description: identical condition, but obstacle_detections is called with held_kind='red', grasp_pwm=closed 1500, i.e. the native kinematic held-object mask (sim/solo_carry_obstacles.py; uses only the issued grasp + current arm commands, never cargo world coordinates)

counterfactual_design.same_scene: crossroom_carry_scene_v1 (reduced single red box) + s1_normal_mixed_v7 base
counterfactual_design.only_difference: the crossroom_carry_mask_v1 toggle (obstacle-channel held-object mask). The wall-foot perception and the policy are byte-identical between arms.
primary_contrast: obstacle detection ticks per episode (own-RGB obstacle detector non-empty ticks)
wall zero share and wall points total
false gap claims vs GT door crossing
box retained (own monitor) and box occlusion share
counterfactual_design.no_pooling: M0 and M1 are reported side by side as a 2-arm contrast and are not pooled with each other, with Stage B baseline, or with any other condition.
counterfactual_design.limitation: masking the obstacle channel cannot restore wall-foot pixels that the box physically occludes; M1 tests the obstacle-channel part of the occlusion hypothesis only. If M1 shows no difference, the earlier Stage B occlusion wording must stay a correlation claim (already qualified in the Stage B results).

setup.loaded_start: setup-only: placement at r1 grip site, gripper closed PWM 1500, 1 SIM s CPU settle, no weld, no teacher
setup.start_valid: authored-start overlap admission before the loaded placement (as Stage B; loaded-state admission is reference-only)

carry_monitor: scripts/carry_state_own.py own-RGB lower-centre red-box monitor (held/uncertain/lost) + own gripper command history; thresholds frozen in queue
success_threshold: none (measurement / counterfactual). The arms are judged by the paired contrast, not by a mission pass; any causal wording must match the measured contrast.
expected_wall: about 2.5-3.0 h per arm (16 x 180 Sim s at the gcp3 batch rate)
